caption: The drawing depicts the side view of a cow rendered in a single, flat, silhouette style. The cow is shown standing on a horizontal base, also drawn in a flat manner. The entire figure, including the base, is colored in shades of muted reddish-brown with patches of lighter pink, blue, and some small, scattered black speckles giving a textured appearance. The edges are outlined in a slightly darker reddish tone. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or patterns present. The cow’s head is turned to the right, and two horns extend upwards from its head. The legs, body, and tail are in profile, with the contours simplified and with no visible internal details or anatomically realistic features besides the general shape.
title: Steer Weather Vane
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
